description: Full Stack Developer with professional experience since 2022 in React, Next.js, Node.js and SQL. I build e-commerce platforms, business management systems and mobile applications.
I work with teams and clients from requirements definition through production deployment, focusing on simplifying processes and improving the user experience.

stages.title: E-commerce, internal tools, and mobile application
list: Migrated the e-commerce platform to Next.js 14, improving performance by 30%. The platform serves an average of 2,000 users per hour.
Reorganized the project and built reusable components and responsive interfaces with React and Tailwind CSS, incorporating UX improvements.
Built internal tools for multiple departments, automating manual tasks to save staff time.
Manage production deployments and updates with Docker. I share frontend technical decisions and planning, and mentored new team members during onboarding.
Collaborated with the backend team on PHP features and staging tasks. I am currently migrating functionality from PHP to the Next.js server with direct SQL database access to reduce response times.
Created and updated email templates for e-commerce communications.
For a bar, another business owned by my contractor, I independently developed a React Native and Expo app and prepared its App Store and Google Play releases.
The project includes a dashboard for managing notifications, events, and content, tracking users and purchases, and running a points-based loyalty program.

stages.title: Website
list: Built the furniture manufacturer’s website with Next.js and React. I defined the architecture, designed the UI/UX, and agreed on requirements and deliveries with the client.

stages.title: ERP and CRM management system
list: Digitized the factory’s processes in a multi-user application with production traceability and metrics by department for decision-making.
Integrated customer and financial management, including projected and actual expenses, payments, outflows, and payroll.
Defined requirements, designed the interfaces, and managed deployment. I continue to add improvements in collaboration with the client.

stages.title: Website redesign
list: Implemented the redesign of the existing website, coordinating with the designer and client from requirements through deployment.

stages.title: Billing and management system
list: Built a multi-user internal tool for a dress sales and rental business, integrating ARCA invoicing, customer management, invoice history, and automatic email delivery.
Managed deployment, domain and email configuration, and the client launch. I continue to add features on request.

stages.title: Client websites
list: Built portfolios, e-commerce sites, blogs, and landing pages with WordPress, React, and Next.js.
Implemented features and API integrations with attention to performance and code quality. Worked with Scrum and Git-based version control.

firstParagraph.text: More than 700 hours of intensive learning in Full Stack development, applying agile methodologies (Scrum). Development of an individual project (SPA) and a group project focused on e-commerce.
